name: Color Blindness Simulator
summary: Preview how a color appears under protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, and achromatopsia.
description: Enter any hex color and see approximate simulations for common color-vision deficiencies. Useful for accessibility reviews alongside contrast checking.

faqs.question: How accurate is this?
faqs.answer: It uses standard approximation matrices for quick design checks — not a medical diagnostic tool.
